items.region: 中亚（哈萨克斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦、乌兹别克斯坦等）
items.shelf_zh: 晒干后常温可存放一年以上（哈萨克传统做法口径）。
items.flavor_zh: 很咸、很酸、很硬，入口像一颗粉笔质感的咸酸奶球，慢慢含化；也用温水泡开煮汤或兑成饮料。
items.flavor_en: Intensely salty, sour and hard, like a chalky ball of salted yogurt that dissolves slowly in the mouth; also crumbled into soups or whisked into a drink with warm water.
items.how_zh: 羊奶、山羊奶或牛奶加热后接种酸奶引子发酵，搅出黄油，剩下的酸酪浆（ayran）煮到析出白色凝块，用布包压干，按重量加 2–3% 盐，再捏成 30–40 克的小球或椭圆，日晒 10–15 天。
items.how_en: Sheep, goat or cow milk is heated, soured with a yogurt starter and churned; the leftover sour buttermilk (ayran) is boiled until white curds rise, pressed in cloth, salted at 2–3% by weight, shaped into 30–40 g balls and sun-dried for 10–15 days.

history.zh: 18 世纪俄国学者伊万·安德烈耶夫记载，哈萨克人用牛奶和羊奶做的 qurt「看上去像晒干的奶酪」；19 世纪的列夫申则记载吉尔吉斯（哈萨克）人把它装在鞍袋里当旅途干粮。
history.en: The 18th-century Russian writer Ivan Andreev noted that Kazakh qurt made from cow and sheep milk 'looks like a dried cheese'; the 19th-century writer Levshin described it as a traveller's food carried in saddlebags.

sources.title: Oskenbay M. Fermented Dairy Products in Central Asia: Methods for Making Kazakh Qurt and their Health Benefits. Crossroads 14 (2016) 205–218

history.zh: 2022 年一项研究测得发酵沥干后的库鲁特 pH 约 3.7–4.0，并引述其他研究给出的范围为 pH 3.6–4.9。
history.en: A 2022 study measured strained kurut at about pH 3.7–4.0 and cited a reported range of pH 3.6–4.9.

sources.title: Tuganbay A., Yousefvand A., Saris P.E.J. Production of kurut (kurt) using probiotic Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG… Frontiers in Food Science and Technology 2 (2022)

items.shelf_zh: 完全晒干后常温可存放数月至一年以上，是游牧人的冬储与远行干粮。
items.flavor_zh: 酸、微甜或无甜，奶味浓，质地从酥脆到硬如石头不等，要含在嘴里慢慢软化。
items.flavor_en: Sour, faintly sweet or not at all, intensely milky; ranges from crumbly to rock-hard and is softened slowly in the mouth.
items.how_zh: 牛奶先发酵成酸奶（常先蒸馏出奶酒，用剩下的酸凝乳），加热使凝块析出，用布包压去乳清，切块或用模子压成花纹，摊在蒙古包顶或木架上风干日晒。
items.how_en: Milk is fermented into yogurt (often after distilling milk vodka from it), heated until curds separate, pressed in cloth, then cut or moulded into patterned pieces and dried in the wind and sun on the ger roof or racks.

history.zh: 鲁布鲁克（1253–1255）记载：蒙古人把牛奶尽量放酸后煮沸，凝块在日光下晒得「硬如铁渣」，装袋过冬；冬天缺奶时再把干凝块放入皮囊加水搅化，当奶喝。
history.en: Rubruck (1253–55) recorded that the Mongols soured milk as far as possible, boiled it, and sun-dried the curd until it was 'as hard as iron slag', storing it in bags for winter; when milk ran short they churned it with water in a skin to drink.

sources.title: William of Rubruck, The Journey of William of Rubruck to the Eastern Parts of the World, 1253–55 (tr. W. W. Rockhill, 1900), Silk Road Seattle text

history.zh: 同一记载：先撇出的黄油被熬到完全无水，不加盐装进羊胃里过冬——这与南亚 ghee 的原理相同。
history.en: The same account says the skimmed butter was boiled down until completely dry and stored unsalted in sheep's paunches for winter — the same principle as South Asian ghee.

sources.title: William of Rubruck, The Journey of William of Rubruck to the Eastern Parts of the World, 1253–55 (tr. W. W. Rockhill, 1900), Silk Road Seattle text

items.name_zh: 马奶酒（艾日格 / 忽迷思）
items.shelf_zh: 传统上随挤随酿、边喝边续，夏秋季节饮用；不是长期储存品，作用是把夏季过剩的马奶转成可饮用、不易坏的酸性低度酒。
items.flavor_zh: 酸、微咸、带气泡与轻微酒感，有类似酸奶与青草的气味，口感比牛奶稀薄。
items.flavor_en: Sour, faintly salty, lightly fizzy and boozy, with yogurt-like and grassy notes; thinner than cow's milk.
items.how_zh: 把鲜马奶倒入牛皮囊（khokhuur），加入上一批留下的酒底作引子，反复搅打数百次，让乳酸菌和酵母同时发酵，产生酸味、少量酒精和气泡。
items.how_en: Fresh mare's milk is poured into a cowhide bag (khokhuur) holding a starter from the previous batch and churned hundreds of times, so lactic bacteria and yeasts ferment it together into a sour, lightly alcoholic, fizzy drink.

history.zh: 1253–1255 年出使蒙古的方济各会士鲁布鲁克记载：蒙古人把马奶倒入大皮囊，用中空的棒子搅打，直到起泡、变酸、发酵，称之为 cosmos；贵族喝一种更清澈的「黑马奶」。
history.en: The Franciscan William of Rubruck, travelling to the Mongols in 1253–55, described mare's milk poured into a large skin and churned with a hollow stick until it foamed, soured and fermented into 'cosmos'; nobles drank a clearer 'black cosmos'.

sources.title: William of Rubruck, The Journey of William of Rubruck to the Eastern Parts of the World, 1253–55 (tr. W. W. Rockhill, 1900), Silk Road Seattle text

history.zh: 2019 年，蒙古「用牛皮囊制作艾日格的传统技艺及相关习俗」列入联合国教科文组织人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录；申报材料称需搅打 500 次以上。
history.en: In 2019 Mongolia's 'Traditional technique of making Airag in Khokhuur and its associated customs' was inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List; the file says the milk is churned more than 500 times.

sources.title: UNESCO ICH: Traditional technique of making Airag in Khokhuur and its associated customs (Mongolia, 14.COM, 2019)

history.zh: 2009 年《科学》发表的研究在哈萨克斯坦博泰（Botai）文化约公元前 3500 年的陶片上检出马奶脂肪残留，被视为最早的挤马奶证据。
history.en: A 2009 Science study detected mare's milk fat residues on pottery from the Botai culture of Kazakhstan, about 3500 BC, read as the earliest evidence of horse milking.

sources.title: Outram A.K. et al. The Earliest Horse Harnessing and Milking. Science 323(5919):1332–1335 (2009)

history.alt: 后续古 DNA 研究显示博泰马并非现代家马的主要祖先，挤奶解释也有学者质疑

items.name_zh: 硬曲拉（喜马拉雅硬牦牛奶块）
items.region: 喜马拉雅（尼泊尔东部、锡金、不丹）
items.animal: 牦牛、牦牛与黄牛杂交（犏牛）
items.shelf_zh: 充分干燥的硬曲拉可常温放数月至数年；有媒体称装在牦牛皮袋中可存放近二十年（媒体口径，未见实测）。
items.flavor_zh: 几乎无水分、极硬，含在嘴里慢慢软化，淡淡奶甜与明显烟熏味，像嚼一块奶味的「石头」；一块可嚼两三个小时。
items.flavor_en: Almost moisture-free and rock-hard; it softens slowly in the mouth, faintly milky-sweet and distinctly smoky. One piece can be chewed for two to three hours.
items.how_zh: 牦牛奶或犏牛奶先提出酥油，剩下的脱脂奶 / 酪浆加热凝固，凝块用布包裹挂起沥水、压实成块，切条后用绳串起，挂在灶火上方慢慢烘干熏干数周。
items.how_en: After butter is churned out of yak or yak-cow (chauri) milk, the leftover buttermilk is heated to curdle; the curd is hung in cloth to drain, pressed into a block, cut into pieces, strung up and dried and smoked above the hearth for weeks.

history.zh: 1986 年的一项尼泊尔研究（Karki）把硬曲拉描述为「立方块状的硬化奶酪，像嚼槟榔一样咬着或嚼着吃」；产区涵盖大吉岭山区、锡金、尼泊尔与不丹。
history.en: A 1986 Nepalese study (Karki) described hard chhurpi as 'a hardened cheese in the form of cubes and consumed by biting or chewing as betel nut'; it is made in the Darjeeling hills, Sikkim, Nepal and Bhutan.

sources.title: North Bengal University thesis, Chapter 1 (churpi in Darjeeling, Sikkim, Nepal, Bhutan; citing Karki 1986)

history.zh: 今天硬曲拉大量出口到美国等地做狗咬胶；英国《卫报》报道尼泊尔至少有 30 家相关公司，2021–22 年产值约 2200 万美元。
history.en: Hard chhurpi is now exported in bulk as a dog chew; The Guardian reported at least 30 Nepalese dog-chew companies generating about US$22 million in 2021–22.
history.num: 约 2200 万美元；≥30 家公司

history.en: FAO's The Yak records that Bhutanese herders slice round cheese, boil the pieces in milk, string them 20 to a cord and hang them on a tent pole until 'rock hard'.

items.shelf_zh: 包在皮囊或瘤胃里的酥油可存放一到两年不霉变（久存后含水降到约 3%，但会有陈味）。
items.flavor_zh: 酥油本身带浓郁奶香与微酸的发酵味，陈酥油有明显「哈喇」气；酥油茶咸、油润、带砖茶的涩香，更像一碗汤。
items.flavor_en: Yak butter is rich and slightly tangy from the soured milk; aged butter turns noticeably rancid. Butter tea is salty, oily and astringent from brick tea — closer to a broth than a drink.
items.how_zh: 牦牛奶放一天让它微酸，加温到约 20 °C 倒入高大的木桶，用带圆盘的木杵上下捣 1–4 小时，或装进皮囊摇晃，直到乳脂结成团；捏出水分后用牛犊皮、牦牛瘤胃或宽大硬叶包起来存放。酥油茶是把砖茶熬浓，与酥油、盐一起在长筒里捣匀。
items.how_en: Yak milk is left a day to sour slightly, warmed to about 20 °C and churned in a tall wooden churn for 1–4 hours (or shaken in a hide bag) until the fat gathers; the butter is squeezed and wrapped in calf hide, yak rumen or broad stiff leaves. Butter tea is strong brick tea churned with butter and salt in a long wooden cylinder.

history.zh: 联合国粮农组织《牦牛》一书记载：新制酥油含水 12–15%、蛋白质约 1%，久存的酥油含水约 3%；每包约 50 kg，可放一两年不霉。
history.en: FAO's The Yak records that fresh yak butter holds 12–15% water and about 1% protein, while old butter drops to about 3% water; packs of about 50 kg keep one to two years without moulding.
history.num: 含水 12–15% → 约 3%；每包约 50 kg

history.zh: 鲁布鲁克（1253–1255）记录蒙古人把黄油熬干、不加盐装入羊胃过冬，与高原上用瘤胃、皮囊包裹酥油的做法同属一类「脂肪封存」。
history.en: Rubruck (1253–55) saw the Mongols boil butter dry and store it unsalted in sheep paunches for winter — the same family of fat-in-a-bag storage as the plateau's rumen- and hide-wrapped butter.

items.region: 黎凡特（黎巴嫩、叙利亚、约旦、巴勒斯坦）
items.shelf_zh: 鲜拉布内冷藏约一两周；浸油的拉布内球据称可保存一年以上，越放越酸。
items.flavor_zh: 酸、咸、像奶油奶酪一样细滑；配橄榄油、干薄荷或扎塔尔香料，抹在饼上当早餐。
items.flavor_en: Tangy, salty and smooth like cream cheese; eaten with olive oil, dried mint or za'atar on flatbread for breakfast.
items.how_zh: 加盐的酸奶装进布袋悬挂过滤，滤得比希腊酸奶更久更干，成为可涂抹的软酪；再滤干后可搓成小球，裹上香草或辣椒粉浸进橄榄油（labaneh bil zayt）。贝都因人还把它压干晒成硬块。
items.how_en: Salted yogurt is hung in cloth and drained longer and drier than Greek yogurt into a spreadable soft cheese; drained further, it is rolled into balls, coated with herbs or chilli and submerged in olive oil (labaneh bil zayt). Bedouin producers also press and sun-dry it into hard pieces.

history.zh: 浸油拉布内球在黎巴嫩、巴勒斯坦等地是家庭储存做法：滤到很干的拉布内搓成球泡在橄榄油里，油层隔绝空气，可存放一年以上。
history.en: Oil-preserved labneh balls are a household practice in Lebanon, Palestine and nearby: very dry labneh is rolled and submerged in olive oil, which shuts out air and lets it keep for over a year.

sources.title: Wikipedia: Labneh (lead to Helou, Lebanese Cuisine 1998; Tamimi & Wigley, Falastin 2020)

history.zh: 贝都因人的 labaneh malboudeh 是压干晒硬的拉布内，形态上接近中亚的 qurut。
history.en: Bedouin labaneh malboudeh is pressed and dried hard, much like Central Asian qurut.

items.shelf_zh: 干卡什克常温可存放数月至一年，是农民过冬、士兵和旅人的干粮；液态卡什克需冷藏。
items.flavor_zh: 强烈的咸、酸和发酵的鲜味，像浓缩的酸奶油加帕玛森；拌在烤茄子泥（kashk-e bademjan）和汤面（ash reshteh）上。
items.flavor_en: Intensely salty, sour and savoury — like concentrated sour cream crossed with Parmesan; spooned over smoky aubergine (kashk-e bademjan) and noodle soup (ash reshteh).
items.how_zh: 酸奶搅出黄油后剩下的酸酪浆（doogh）加热浓缩、滤去水分，揉成球或条晒干；用时泡软磨开，现代多以瓶装稠液出售。
items.how_en: The sour buttermilk (doogh) left after churning butter from yogurt is heated, drained and rolled into balls or strips to sun-dry; it is soaked and ground before use, and today is mostly sold as a thick liquid in jars.

history.zh: kashk 一词可追溯到中古波斯语 kašk，词根被认为与「干」有关；在 10 世纪的《列王纪》里它指大麦粉，同期一部阿拉伯语食谱则记有小麦加酵头和酸奶两种 kashk。
history.en: The word goes back to Middle Persian kašk, thought to relate to 'dry'; in the 10th-century Shahnameh it means barley flour, while a 10th-century Arabic cookbook describes two kinds, one of wheat and leaven and one of sour milk.

sources.title: Wikipedia: Kashk (lead to Aubaile-Sallenave 1994, Perry, Moraba 2016)
Moraba K. The Story of Kashk. Gastronomica 16(4):97–100 (2016)

history.zh: 学者对词义演变有两说：一说原指大麦制品，牧民类比借用到干奶制品；另一说据 13 世纪阿拉伯语食谱，把干酸奶称为「土库曼式 kashk」。
history.en: Scholars differ: Aubaile-Sallenave argues the original kashk was barley-based and the dairy sense arose by analogy among pastoralists, while Charles Perry points to a 13th-century Arabic cookbook calling dried yogurt a Turkmen-style kashk.

history.zh: 黎凡特的 kishk 与伊朗 kashk 名字相近但不同：前者是碎小麦（burghul）与酸奶一起发酵、晒干、磨粉，以谷物为主；土耳其与希腊的 tarhana / trachanas 也属同一家族。
history.en: Levantine kishk is a different thing despite the name: bulgur fermented with yogurt, dried and ground — mainly a grain product; Turkish tarhana and Greek trachanas belong to the same family.

items.name_zh: 贾米德（约旦盐渍干酸奶）
items.region: 约旦（卡拉克等南部地区）
items.shelf_zh: 晒干后常温可存放约一年以上（牧区口径），用于跨越无奶的季节。
items.flavor_zh: 非常咸，带强烈的酸和发酵乳的鲜味，化开后像一锅浓稠的咸酸奶汤。
items.flavor_en: Very salty, sharply sour and savoury; dissolved, it becomes a thick, tangy, salty yogurt broth.
items.how_zh: 绵羊奶或山羊奶发酵成酸奶，搅出黄油，剩下的酸酪浆加热、装布袋滤干，按重量揉进大量盐，捏成拳头大小的球或饼，在屋顶晾晒到坚硬。做约旦国菜 mansaf 时，把 jameed 泡软捣成浓酱，与羊肉同煮。
items.how_en: Sheep or goat milk is fermented into yogurt and churned; the sour buttermilk is heated, drained in cloth bags, heavily salted, shaped into fist-sized balls or discs and sun-dried on rooftops until hard. For mansaf it is soaked and pounded into a thick sauce and simmered with lamb.

history.zh: 2024 年 ICARDA 等机构对约旦传统 jameed 的检测：总固形物平均 84.57%（73–92%），盐平均 15.68%，酸度平均 6.79%；生产者用盐抑制晒干过程中的过度酸化。
history.en: A 2024 survey of traditional Jordanian jameed by ICARDA and partners found mean total solids of 84.57% (range 73–92%), mean salt of 15.68% and mean acidity of 6.79%; producers rely on salt to keep acidity in check during drying.

sources.title: Hilali M. et al. Nutritional and Food Safety Characteristics of Jameed – A Traditional Dairy Product of Drylands. Applied Sciences 14(2) (2024)

items.name_zh: 斯门（摩洛哥陈年发酵黄油）
items.shelf_zh: 常温至少可存放六个月；市场上有陈放一两年乃至六年以上的老斯门。
items.flavor_zh: 陈两年的斯门像辛辣的蓝纹奶酪，六年以上的老斯门香气更圆润；少量拌进古斯古斯、塔吉锅调味。
items.flavor_en: Two-year smen tastes like a sharp blue cheese; six-year-old smen is rounder and less sharp. A spoonful seasons couscous and tagines.
items.how_zh: 用发酵奶搅出的黄油洗净、加盐（有时加牛至、百里香煎出的香草水），压去水分装进陶罐或木桶，在常温下陈放数周到数年；脂肪在微生物和酶作用下水解，产生浓烈的「奶酪味」。
items.how_en: Butter churned from soured milk is washed and salted (sometimes worked with an oregano or thyme infusion), pressed dry, packed into clay jars or barrels and aged at room temperature for weeks to years, while microbial and enzymatic lipolysis builds a pungent, cheesy flavour.

history.zh: 1988 年摩洛哥学者对传统斯门的研究显示，非脂相含盐平均约 8%，熟成中酸价平均 52.3 mg KOH/g 脂肪；脂肪水解是人们追求的风味来源，盐和陈放并不能让它保持原样。
history.en: A 1988 Moroccan study found an average of about 8% salt in smen's non-fat phase and a mean acid value of 52.3 mg KOH/g fat; lipolysis is the prized source of flavour, and salting does not keep the butter unchanged.
history.num: 非脂相盐约 8%；常温 ≥6 个月

sources.title: El Marrakchi A. et al. La flore microbienne du smen marocain. II. Flores lipolytique et caséolytique. Le Lait 68(3):333–348 (1988)

history.zh: 非斯（Fez）有专门的「斯门广场」市场；流传的说法是柏柏尔人在女儿出生那天埋下一罐斯门，到她出嫁时再挖出来——这是传说。
history.en: Fez has a dedicated smen market square; a popular story holds that Berber families buried a jar of smen when a daughter was born and dug it up for her wedding — a legend.

sources.title: NPR The Salt: Smen Is Morocco's Funky Fermented Butter That Lasts For Years (Alex Schmidt, 2014-10-09)
El Marrakchi A. et al. La flore microbienne du smen marocain. II. Flores lipolytique et caséolytique. Le Lait 68(3):333–348 (1988)

items.name_zh: 酥油 / 印度澄清黄油
items.region: 南亚（印度、巴基斯坦、尼泊尔等）
items.shelf_zh: 含水约 0.2%，密封避光常温可存放数月；主要限制是脂肪氧化酸败，而不是细菌。
items.flavor_zh: 坚果、焦糖、烤奶的香气，熬制温度越高香味越浓；冷却后呈颗粒状半固体。
items.flavor_en: Nutty, toasty, caramelised-milk aroma that deepens with higher cooking temperatures; sets into a grainy semi-solid when cool.
items.how_zh: 传统做法先把牛奶或水牛奶发酵成 dahi（酸奶），搅打出黄油，再在敞口锅里慢火熬煮，蒸干水分；乳蛋白沉底微焦后滤掉，只留金黄透明的乳脂。
items.how_en: Traditionally, cow or buffalo milk is set into dahi (yogurt) and churned into butter, which is simmered in an open pan until the water boils off; the milk solids settle and brown and are strained away, leaving clear golden butterfat.

history.zh: 酥油（梵语 ghṛta）自吠陀时代起就是火祭（yajña、homa）中投入圣火的供品；《梨俱吠陀》中有专门赞颂酥油的颂诗。
history.en: Ghee (Sanskrit ghṛta) has been the offering poured into the sacred fire in Vedic yajña and homa rituals since the Vedic period; the Rigveda contains a hymn in praise of ghee.

sources.title: Wikipedia: Ghee (lead for composition and Vedic ritual use)

history.note: Rigveda 4.58 原文页面未能打开

history.zh: 阿育吠陀把用草药熬制的酥油称为 ghṛta（药用酥油），作为药物载体；2014 年一项研究发现按传统阿育吠陀方法制得的酥油 DHA 含量显著更高。
history.en: Ayurveda uses herb-infused ghee (ghṛta) as a vehicle for medicines; a 2014 study found significantly higher DHA in ghee made by the traditional Ayurvedic method.

sources.title: Joshi K.S. Docosahexaenoic acid content is significantly higher in ghrita prepared by traditional Ayurvedic method. J Ayurveda Integr Med 5(2):85–88 (2014)

items.shelf_zh: 奶膏本身水分活度约 0.97，常温只能放约两天；加糖做成 peda 后，冷藏约两周，气调包装可在 20 °C 放约 30 天。它的作用更多是把鲜奶变成能当天运进城的半成品。
items.flavor_zh: 浓郁的熟奶与焦糖香，微颗粒感；做成 peda 后像入口即化的奶糖，常加小豆蔻和藏红花。
items.flavor_en: Rich cooked-milk and caramel flavour with a slightly grainy texture; as peda it melts like milk fudge, often scented with cardamom and saffron.
items.how_zh: 水牛奶或牛奶在宽口铁锅中大火不停翻炒蒸发，熬到只剩约五分之一、成为面团状的奶膏（khoa / mawa）；加糖再炒干，就是 peda、burfi 等奶糖类甜点。
items.how_en: Buffalo or cow milk is boiled down in a wide iron pan with constant scraping until about a fifth remains as a dough-like paste (khoa or mawa); cooked further with sugar, it becomes sweets such as peda and burfi.

history.zh: 印度乳品研究教材指出：市售奶膏常温约 48 小时后就会因微生物而变质；把水分活度从 0.97 降到 0.93 也没有明显增强保存效果。
history.en: Indian dairy-microbiology course material notes that market khoa spoils from microbial action after about 48 hours at ambient temperature, and that lowering its aw from 0.97 to 0.93 does not noticeably improve keeping.
history.num: aw 约 0.97；常温约 48 小时

sources.title: Kumar R. Microbiology of Indigenous Milk Products: Desiccated Milk Based Products (course slides DTM-222, Bihar Animal Sciences University, 2020)

history.zh: 2020 年印度乳品科学研究：用水牛奶奶膏加糖制成的 peda 冷藏保质期最长约 15 天；另有研究显示气调包装可使 peda 在 37 °C 下保存 15 天、20 °C 下保存 30 天。
history.en: A 2020 Indian Journal of Dairy Science study gives buffalo-milk khoa-peda a maximum refrigerated shelf life of about 15 days; modified-atmosphere packaging has been reported to extend peda to 15 days at 37 °C and 30 days at 20 °C.

items.note: khoa 本身并不耐放，严格说是浓缩而非保存；如页面需要「保存」故事，可改用加糖的 peda，或换成罐装 rasgulla

items.shelf_zh: 新鲜斯基尔冷藏约数周；历史上真正用于长期储存的是酸乳清 sýra——浸在其中的食物可以过冬。
items.flavor_zh: 浓稠、细滑、酸度清爽，奶味干净，比希腊酸奶更紧实。
items.flavor_en: Thick, smooth and cleanly tart; denser than Greek yogurt.
items.how_zh: 脱脂奶加热后，用上一批的斯基尔做引子（后来也加凝乳酶）让它变酸凝固，再用布过滤掉大量乳清，得到稠厚的高蛋白凝乳。滤出的乳清再发酵成 sýra，用来浸泡腌渍肉类等食物过冬。
items.how_en: Skimmed milk is heated and soured with a spoonful of the previous batch (later also with rennet), then strained through cloth to remove much of the whey, leaving a thick, high-protein curd. The whey was fermented further into sýra and used to pickle meat and other foods for winter.

history.zh: 冰岛早期移民从挪威带来斯基尔的做法；这一传统后来在挪威和其他北欧国家消失，只在冰岛延续下来。
history.en: Iceland's settlers brought skyr-making from Norway; the tradition later died out in Norway and the rest of Scandinavia and survived only in Iceland.

sources.title: Plédel Jónsson D. The Cheese of the North. FÆÐA | FOOD (icelandicfood.is), 2020

history.zh: 在缺盐、缺柴（难以烟熏）的冰岛，做斯基尔剩下的乳清被用来腌渍肉食，形成「súrmatur（酸食）」，今天主要在冬末的 Þorri 节吃到。
history.en: In salt-poor, wood-poor Iceland, whey from skyr-making was used to pickle meat, creating súrmatur ('sour food'), now eaten mainly at the late-winter Þorri feasts.

sources.title: Plédel Jónsson D. The Cheese of the North. FÆÐA | FOOD (icelandicfood.is), 2020

history.zh: 传统斯基尔 2015 年入选慢食基金会「守护者」（Presidia）名录，是第一个入选的冰岛产品；2011 年冰岛 Matís 研究所报告称传统斯基尔的菌群有独特之处。
history.en: Traditional skyr joined Slow Food's Presidia in 2015, the first Icelandic product to do so; a 2011 Matís report found its microbiota distinctive.

sources.title: Plédel Jónsson D. The Cheese of the North. FÆÐA | FOOD (icelandicfood.is), 2020
Matís: peer-reviewed articles on skyr (incl. Valsdóttir & Sveinsson 2011, The Distinct Qualities of Traditional Skyr)
Plédel Jónsson D. The Cheese of the North. FÆÐA | FOOD (icelandicfood.is), 2020
Matís: peer-reviewed articles on skyr (incl. Valsdóttir & Sveinsson 2011, The Distinct Qualities of Traditional Skyr)

items.note: 分类上属于酸凝鲜奶酪，但按酸奶食用；萨迦中提及 skyr 的具体章节未核

items.name_zh: 维利与菲尔牛奶（北欧黏丝发酵奶）
items.shelf_zh: 冷藏约两周；菌种可在家中以室温代代相传。
items.flavor_zh: 温和的酸、带奶油与淡淡蘑菇般的霉香，舀起时会拉出长长的黏丝。
items.flavor_en: Mildly sour, creamy, with a faint mushroomy note from the surface mould; it pulls into long, stretchy strands off the spoon.
items.how_zh: 牛奶在室温下接种上一批的维利（或菌种）发酵约一天；嗜温乳酸乳球菌分泌的胞外多糖让它拉出长丝，表面再长出一层天鹅绒般的白色霉菌（白地霉）。
items.how_en: Milk is seeded with a spoonful of the previous batch and left at room temperature for about a day; exopolysaccharide from mesophilic Lactococcus lactis subsp. cremoris makes it stretch into long, ropy strands, and a velvety film of the mould Geotrichum candidum forms on top.

history.zh: 维利的独特质地来自黏液型乳酸乳球菌产生的含磷杂多糖（viilian）；2008 年芬兰研究从传统维利中分离并鉴定了这些发酵菌。
history.en: Viili's texture comes from a phosphate-containing heteropolysaccharide (viilian) made by slime-forming Lactococcus lactis subsp. cremoris; a 2008 Finnish study isolated and characterised these starter bacteria from traditional viili.

sources.title: Kahala M. et al. Characterization of starter lactic acid bacteria from the Finnish fermented milk product viili. Journal of Applied Microbiology 105(6):1929–1938 (2008)
Wikipedia: Viili

history.zh: 瑞典与芬兰西部有一族类似的发酵奶：filmjölk、更黏的 långfil、filbunke 等，挪威称 kulturmelk 或 surmelk。
history.en: Western Finland and Sweden share a family of similar soured milks — filmjölk, the extra-ropy långfil, filbunke — called kulturmelk or surmelk in Norway.

sources.title: Wikipedia: Viili
Kahala M. et al. Characterization of starter lactic acid bacteria from the Finnish fermented milk product viili. Journal of Applied Microbiology 105(6):1929–1938 (2008)
Wikipedia: Viili

items.note: 历史年代证据不足；林奈 1737《拉普兰植物志》用捕虫堇叶子做黏奶一说未核

items.shelf_zh: 冷藏约一至几周；开菲尔粒本身只要持续喂奶可以无限传代。
items.flavor_zh: 酸、微微起泡、带酵母和轻微酒香，比酸奶稀，可直接喝。
items.flavor_en: Tart, lightly effervescent, with a yeasty, faintly alcoholic note; thinner than yogurt and drunk from a glass.
items.how_zh: 把开菲尔粒（由乳酸菌、酵母包裹在多糖「开菲尔多糖」里形成的菜花状颗粒）按 2–5% 放进牛奶，在约 20–25 °C 下发酵 12–24 小时，滤出颗粒留作下一批，液体即开菲尔。传统上装在山羊皮袋里挂在门边，路过的人顺手拍打搅动。
items.how_en: Kefir grains — cauliflower-like clusters of lactic bacteria and yeasts bound in the polysaccharide kefiran — are added to milk at 2–5% and fermented at about 20–25 °C for 12–24 hours; the grains are strained out for the next batch. Traditionally it was made in goatskin bags hung by the door and knocked by passers-by.

history.zh: 「kefir」一词源自北高加索语言，卡拉恰伊-巴尔卡尔语称 gıpı，与意为「酒囊 / 皮囊」的词同源；19 世纪末 20 世纪初卡拉恰伊开菲尔曾以「皮囊」之名出售。
history.en: The word kefir is of North Caucasian origin; Karachay-Balkar gıpı is linked to a word for 'wineskin', and Karachay kefir was sold under that name in the late 19th and early 20th centuries.

sources.title: Wikipedia: Kefir (lead to Prado et al. 2015 Front. Microbiol. doi:10.3389/fmicb.2015.01177 and Karachay-Balkar etymology)
Prado M.R. et al. Milk kefir: composition, microbial cultures, biological activities, and related products. Frontiers in Microbiology 6:1177 (2015)

history.zh: 2024 年中国科学院古脊椎动物与古人类研究所团队在《细胞》发表研究：新疆小河墓地约 3600 年前的乳制品残留是开菲尔奶酪，从中测出开菲尔乳杆菌的古 DNA。
history.en: In 2024 a team led from the Institute of Vertebrate Paleontology and Paleoanthropology (CAS) reported in Cell that roughly 3,600-year-old dairy residues from the Xiaohe cemetery in Xinjiang are kefir cheese, recovering ancient DNA of Lactobacillus kefiranofaciens.

sources.title: Liu Y. et al. Bronze Age cheese reveals human–Lactobacillus interactions over evolutionary history. Cell 187 (2024)

history.note: 未打开原文，依据作者记忆与维基引文；与研究员 A/B 的奶酪起源部分可能重叠

history.zh: 相传 1908 年前后，莫斯科布兰多夫兄弟的乳品厂派女职员伊琳娜·萨哈罗娃去高加索向一位王公求取开菲尔粒，遭「抢婚」后获救，沙皇判王公赔给她十磅开菲尔粒；1908 年 9 月莫斯科开始出售瓶装开菲尔。这个故事细节多无出处，宜视为传说。
history.en: A popular story says that around 1908 the Blandov brothers' Moscow dairy sent employee Irina Sakharova to obtain kefir grains from a Caucasian prince, who had her abducted; after her rescue the Tsar ordered him to give her ten pounds of grains, and bottled kefir went on sale in Moscow in September 1908. The details are unsourced and best treated as legend.

sources.title: Russian Life: Magical Kefir (Philip Seifi, 2016-08-22)

items.shelf_zh: 冷藏约一至两周（商品口径）；历史上是把易酸的鲜奶油延长数天的办法。
items.flavor_zh: 浓厚、坚果般的熟奶香，表皮略带焦黄；质地介于黄油和打发奶油之间，配司康与果酱。
items.flavor_en: Rich, nutty, cooked-milk flavour with a slightly caramelised crust; texture between butter and whipped cream, served with scones and jam.
items.how_zh: 全脂牛奶或浓奶油倒进浅盘，用蒸汽或热水浴慢慢加热，再长时间缓慢冷却，奶油浮到表面结成一层带金黄硬皮的厚脂；加热杀死大部分微生物，高脂低水让它比鲜奶油耐放。
items.how_en: Whole milk or cream in shallow pans is heated slowly by steam or water bath, then cooled slowly for many hours; the fat rises into a thick layer with a golden crust. Heating kills most microbes, and the high-fat, low-water clot keeps longer than fresh cream.

history.zh: 「康沃尔凝脂奶油」1998 年获欧盟原产地名称保护（PDO），要求使用康沃尔所产牛奶、乳脂不低于 55%；脱欧后转入英国本国保护体系。
history.en: 'Cornish clotted cream' gained EU Protected Designation of Origin status in 1998, requiring Cornish milk and at least 55% butterfat; after Brexit it moved to the UK scheme.

sources.title: GOV.UK Protected food name: Cornish Clotted Cream (PDO)
Commission Regulation (EC) No 2088/98 (registration of Cornish clotted cream PDO)

history.zh: 1579 年斯宾塞的长诗《牧人月历》已提到 clouted cream，1658 年的食谱书《The Compleat Cook》收有做法。
history.en: Edmund Spenser's The Shepheardes Calender (1579) mentions 'clouted cream', and the 1658 cookbook The Compleat Cook gives a recipe.

sources.title: Wikipedia: Clotted cream (lead to Hawker 1881, Davidson Oxford Companion to Food)

history.zh: 民间传说腓尼基商人来康沃尔贩锡时带来了这种做法——这是传说，并无文献证据。
history.en: Folklore says Phoenician tin traders brought the method to Cornwall; this is legend, not documented history.

items.shelf_zh: 考古出土者已在泥炭中存放数百至三千余年；放射性碳测年显示埋藏传统跨越约公元前1700年至17世纪。
items.flavor_zh: 出土物多已变成蜡状、发白的脂肪块，气味被描述为陈年奶酪般的强烈气味；并非供今日食用。
items.flavor_en: Excavated lumps have turned into a pale, waxy fat with a strong, aged-cheese-like smell; not something eaten today.
items.how_zh: 把黄油装进木桶、木盒或用树皮、兽皮包裹，埋进泥炭沼泽。沼泽低温、缺氧、偏酸，微生物活动极慢，脂肪得以长期保存。
items.how_en: Butter was packed into wooden kegs or boxes, or wrapped in bark or hide, and buried in peat bogs, whose cold, oxygen-poor, acidic conditions slow microbial activity to a crawl.

history.zh: 2019 年都柏林大学、布里斯托大学等团队对 32 件爱尔兰沼泽黄油做同位素分析，首次确证其原料是乳脂（而非动物体脂）。
history.en: In 2019 a team from UCD, the University of Bristol and others analysed 32 Irish bog butters and gave the first conclusive evidence that they are dairy fat rather than animal body fat.

sources.title: Smyth J. et al. Four millennia of dairy surplus and deposition revealed through compound-specific stable isotope analysis and radiocarbon dating of Irish bog butters. Scientific Reports 9:4559 (2019)
UCD News: Irish bog butter proven to be 3,500 years past its best before date (2019-03-14)

history.zh: 放射性碳测年显示，最早的一件（韦斯特米斯郡 Knockdrin）约为公元前1745–前1635年；埋藏传统至少延续约3500年，直到17世纪。
history.en: Radiocarbon dating put the oldest sample (Knockdrin, Co. Westmeath) at about 1745–1635 BC, and showed the practice lasting at least 3,500 years, into the 17th century AD.

sources.title: Smyth J. et al. Four millennia of dairy surplus and deposition revealed through compound-specific stable isotope analysis and radiocarbon dating of Irish bog butters. Scientific Reports 9:4559 (2019)
UCD News: Irish bog butter proven to be 3,500 years past its best before date (2019-03-14)

history.zh: 研究者认为埋藏目的不止一种：既可能是储存和保护贵重的乳脂剩余，也可能带有供奉意味——黄油与金器都常见于沼泽埋藏。
history.en: Researchers think there was no single reason: storage and protection of a valuable dairy surplus is likely, and a votive meaning is possible, since butter and gold are both commonly deposited in bogs.

sources.title: Smyth J. et al. Four millennia of dairy surplus and deposition revealed through compound-specific stable isotope analysis and radiocarbon dating of Irish bog butters. Scientific Reports 9:4559 (2019)
UCD News: Irish bog butter proven to be 3,500 years past its best before date (2019-03-14)

items.name_zh: 棕奶酪 / 乳清焦糖奶酪（挪威）
items.shelf_zh: 块状棕奶酪水分低于 25%，冷藏可存放数月；可涂抹的 prim 水分在 30% 以上，保存期较短。
items.flavor_zh: 焦糖、太妃糖般的甜味，带微咸和乳酸的酸度，山羊乳清版有羊膻香；质地紧实带黏性，常用刨刀刨成薄片放在面包或华夫饼上。
items.flavor_en: Sweet like caramel or fudge with a slight saltiness and tang; goat versions add a goaty note. Dense and slightly sticky, shaved thin with a cheese slicer onto bread or waffles.
items.how_zh: 把做奶酪剩下的乳清（常加入牛奶、奶油，山羊乳清版另加羊奶）长时间熬煮，蒸发掉约九成水分；乳清里的乳糖在接近 100 °C 时发生焦糖化 / 美拉德反应变成棕色，快速搅拌冷却后成块。
items.how_en: Whey left over from cheesemaking, often with added milk and cream (goat's milk for geitost), is boiled down until about 90% of the water is gone; near 100 °C the lactose browns through caramelisation and Maillard reactions, and the mass is stirred and cooled quickly into blocks.

history.zh: 挪威大百科称，棕奶酪类产品在 15 世纪的文献中已有记载。
history.en: Store norske leksikon notes that brown whey products appear in sources from the 1400s.

sources.title: Store norske leksikon: brunost

history.zh: 19 世纪 60 年代，古德布兰河谷的挤奶女工 Anne Hov（原姓 Solbrå，1846 年生）在熬乳清时加入奶油，做出更肥厚的「肥奶酪」，后来发展成今天的 Gudbrandsdalsost。
history.en: In the 1860s Anne Hov (née Solbrå, b. 1846), a milkmaid in Gudbrandsdalen, added cream to boiling whey to make a richer 'fat cheese', the ancestor of today's Gudbrandsdalsost.

sources.title: Store norske leksikon: brunost

history.en: In January 2013 a lorry carrying 27 tonnes of brunost caught fire in a tunnel in Tysfjord, Norway; the fat and sugar kept the blaze going for days.

items.name_zh: 尼特基贝（埃塞俄比亚香料澄清黄油）
items.shelf_zh: 比黄油耐放得多，常温可放数月；香料中的抗氧化成分被认为能延缓酸败。
items.flavor_zh: 浓烈的香料与熟黄油香，带草本（罗勒、koseret）、姜和豆蔻的温热感；是 doro wat 等炖菜的底味。
items.flavor_en: Heady and aromatic — browned butter with herbal basil and koseret, warm ginger and cardamom; the base of stews like doro wat.
items.how_zh: 埃塞俄比亚传统上用自然发酵的牛奶搅出黄油（kibe），再与洋葱、大蒜、姜、koseret（Lippia adoensis）、紫罗勒 besobila、korarima 豆蔻、葫芦巴等香料一起慢熬，滤去奶渣，得到带香料的澄清黄油。新鲜的 ayib（酸凝鲜奶酪）则是同一桶酪浆的副产品。
items.how_en: Ethiopian butter (kibe) is churned from naturally fermented milk, then simmered with onion, garlic, ginger, koseret (Lippia adoensis), purple basil (besobila), korarima cardamom, fenugreek and other spices, and strained into a spiced clarified butter. Fresh ayib, a soft acid-curd cheese, comes from the leftover buttermilk.

history.zh: 2005 年埃塞俄比亚药学研究测试了传统用于给烹饪黄油调香的四种植物：Lippia adoensis var. koseret、紫罗勒（Ocimum basilicum var. purpurascens）、姜、korarima 豆蔻；四者精油都有自由基清除活性，以紫罗勒最强，为「防止黄油酸败」的传统做法提供了一个解释。
history.en: A 2005 Ethiopian study of four plants traditionally used to spice cooking butter — koseret, purple basil, ginger and korarima — found radical-scavenging activity in all their volatile oils, strongest in purple basil, offering one explanation for the tradition of preventing rancidity.

sources.title: Sishu R., Yonathan M., Seyoum A., Asres K. Radical scavenging activity of volatile oils of herbs traditionally used to spice cooking butter in Ethiopia. Ethiopian Pharmaceutical Journal 23(1):7–14 (2005)

history.zh: 2017 年综述指出，埃塞俄比亚黄油由自然发酵奶搅制而成，是澄清黄油的原料；澄清黄油比黄油更耐储存，但两者在传统条件下的品质数据仍很缺乏。
history.en: A 2017 review notes that Ethiopian butter is churned from naturally fermented milk and is the raw material for ghee, which keeps better than butter, while quality data under traditional conditions remain scarce.

sources.title: Gemechu A.T., Tola Y.B. Traditional butter and ghee production, processing and handling in Ethiopia: A review. African Journal of Food Science 11(4):95–105 (2017)

items.name_zh: 炭熏葫芦发酵奶（马赛人 kule naoto、卡伦金人 mursik）
items.name_en: Charcoal-smoked gourd milk (Maasai kule naoto, Kalenjin mursik)
items.region: 肯尼亚裂谷地区（马赛人、卡伦金人）
items.shelf_zh: 一般发酵 3–5 天后饮用，可存放数周；有研究引述某些群体的处理奶可放至三个月，波科特人的一种制品据称可放一年以上。
items.flavor_zh: 酸、带明显烟熏与木炭味，常呈蓝灰色并夹有黑色炭屑。
items.flavor_en: Sour with a distinct smoky, charcoal flavour, often bluish-grey and flecked with black ash.
items.how_zh: 葫芦容器先用特定树木燃烧的枝条熏烤、把炭灰擦在内壁，再倒入牛奶，盖严后在阴凉处自然发酵数天。炭层封住葫芦的孔隙，烟熏抑制杂菌，乳酸菌把奶变酸。
items.how_en: A gourd is smoked with burning sticks of chosen trees and its inside rubbed with the charcoal; milk is then poured in, capped and left to ferment naturally for several days. The charcoal seals the gourd's pores, the smoke suppresses unwanted microbes, and lactic bacteria sour the milk.

history.zh: 2004 年对 22 份马赛 kule naoto 样本的研究发现，乳酸菌占主导，其中植物乳杆菌约占 60%；15 份样本未检出肠杆菌，这些样本 pH 均低于 4.5。
history.en: A 2004 study of 22 Maasai kule naoto samples found lactic acid bacteria dominant, with Lactobacillus plantarum about 60% of isolates; in 15 samples no Enterobacteriaceae were detected, all with pH below 4.5.

sources.title: Mathara J.M. et al. Isolation, identification and characterisation of the dominant microorganisms of kule naoto: the Maasai traditional fermented milk in Kenya. Int. J. Food Microbiology 94 (2004) 269–278

history.zh: 2000 年对肯尼亚特兰斯-恩佐亚 60 户农户的调查：最常用的熏葫芦树种是 Senna didymobotrya，其次为 Lippia kituiensis、非洲李（Prunus africana）、非洲油橄榄；73% 的受访者提到「保存」是用炭的目的，86% 提到风味。
history.en: A 2000 survey of 60 farmers in Trans-Nzoia, Kenya ranked Senna didymobotrya first among trees used to treat gourds, followed by Lippia kituiensis, Prunus africana and African olive; 73% cited preservation and 86% flavour as reasons.

sources.title: Mureithi W. et al. Management of Trees Used in Mursik (Fermented Milk) Production in Trans-Nzoia District, Kenya. Journal of Ethnobiology 20(1):75–91 (2000)

history.zh: 同一调查记录的口述史认为这一做法约有 300 年历史。
history.en: Oral history recorded in the same survey dates the practice to about 300 years ago.

sources.title: Mureithi W. et al. Management of Trees Used in Mursik (Fermented Milk) Production in Trans-Nzoia District, Kenya. Journal of Ethnobiology 20(1):75–91 (2000)

items.name_zh: 牛奶焦糖酱（dulce de leche / cajeta）
items.shelf_zh: 高糖低水，开罐前常温可存放数月；开封后冷藏。
items.flavor_zh: 浓郁的焦糖、太妃糖与熟奶香，比焦糖酱更圆润厚实；cajeta 带山羊奶的轻微膻香。
items.flavor_en: Deep caramel, toffee and cooked-milk flavour, rounder and thicker than caramel sauce; cajeta adds a light goaty tang.
items.how_zh: 牛奶加糖（常加一小撮小苏打）用小火不停搅拌熬 1.5–2 小时，蒸发到原体积约六分之一，乳糖与蛋白质发生美拉德反应和焦糖化，变成棕色浓酱。墨西哥 cajeta 用山羊奶，也常加牛奶混合。
items.how_en: Milk and sugar (often with a pinch of baking soda) are simmered and stirred for 1.5–2 hours until reduced to about a sixth of the volume; Maillard browning and caramelisation turn it into a thick brown spread. Mexican cajeta uses goat's milk, often blended with cow's.

history.zh: 有据可查的早期记录包括：1693 和 1712 年从智利向阿根廷输入 manjar（牛奶焦糖类甜品）；1773 年巴西米纳斯吉拉斯已有 doce de leite；1818–1825 年瑞士医生伦格尔记录巴拉圭人食用。
history.en: Documented early records include manjar shipped from Chile to Argentina in 1693 and 1712, doce de leite in Minas Gerais, Brazil, in 1773, and Swiss physician Rengger's account of it in Paraguay in 1818–25.

sources.title: Wikipedia: Dulce de leche (lead to documented records: Minas Gerais 1773, Chilean manjar imports 1693/1712, Rengger 1818–25; Día Internacional del Dulce de Leche since 1998)

history.zh: 阿根廷流行的「1829 年卡涅拉斯」故事——女仆为罗萨斯与拉瓦耶签约时熬奶忘关火而意外发明——是流传的起源神话，没有文献依据。
history.en: The popular Argentine tale that a maid invented it by accident while Rosas and Lavalle met at Cañuelas in 1829 is an origin myth without documentary support.

items.shelf_zh: 甜炼乳水分活度约 0.80–0.87，未开罐常温可存放一年以上（商品口径）；开罐后冷藏约一两周。
items.flavor_zh: 极甜、浓稠，带熟奶与淡淡焦糖味；在东南亚、拉美用来调咖啡、做甜点。
items.flavor_en: Very sweet and thick, with cooked-milk and faint caramel notes; stirred into coffee and desserts across Southeast Asia and Latin America.
items.how_zh: 在真空锅中低温蒸发鲜奶的大部分水分，再装罐密封；后来普遍加入大量蔗糖做成甜炼乳，靠高糖把水分活度压低，开罐前可常温存放。
items.how_en: Milk is evaporated at low temperature in a vacuum pan and sealed in cans; the later sweetened version adds a large dose of sugar, which lowers water activity enough to keep unopened cans at room temperature.

history.zh: 1856 年 8 月 19 日，盖尔·博登获美国专利 15,553 号「牛奶浓缩的改进」，要点是在真空中蒸发牛奶、隔绝空气；专利声明产品「不掺糖或其他外来物」。
history.en: On 19 August 1856 Gail Borden Jr. received US Patent 15,553, 'Improvement in Concentration of Milk', for evaporating milk in a vacuum away from air; the claim specifies the product has 'no sugar or other foreign matter mixed with it'.

sources.title: Borden G. Jr., Improvement in Concentration of Milk, US Patent 15,553 (1856-08-19)

history.zh: 博登 1856、1857 年在康涅狄格开厂均失败，1858 年在纽约金融家杰里迈亚·米尔班克支持下重新开厂；南北战争带来的军需让炼乳生意站稳。
history.en: Borden's Connecticut ventures failed in 1856 and 1857; a new factory backed by New York financier Jeremiah Milbank opened in 1858, and Civil War demand secured the business.

items.region: 全球；工业化后新西兰、欧盟等为主要出口地
items.shelf_zh: 含水低于 4%，密封常温可存放约一年以上（全脂奶粉因脂肪氧化较短，脱脂奶粉更长）。
items.flavor_zh: 冲调后有淡淡的熟奶与焦糖味，与鲜奶相比香气较闷；直接吃干粉有奶糖般的甜香。
items.flavor_en: Reconstituted, it tastes faintly cooked and caramel-like, flatter than fresh milk; eaten dry it has a milky-sweet, candy-like aroma.
items.how_zh: 先把牛奶真空浓缩，再用喷雾干燥（把浓缩奶喷成细雾送进热风室，瞬间变成粉）或滚筒干燥（涂在加热的金属辊上刮下薄片），水分降到 4% 以下。
items.how_en: Milk is first vacuum-concentrated, then spray-dried (atomised into a hot-air chamber where droplets flash into powder) or roller-dried (spread on heated drums and scraped off), bringing moisture below 4%.

history.zh: 13 世纪马可·波罗的游记中有一种被认为是奶粉的产品；鲁布鲁克同时期记载蒙古人把奶凝块晒得「硬如铁渣」，冬天再兑水搅化当奶喝。
history.en: Marco Polo's 13th-century account describes a product thought to be dried milk; at the same time Rubruck recorded Mongols drying milk curd 'as hard as iron slag' and churning it back into a drink with water in winter.

sources.title: Carić M., Gregurek Lj. Retrospektiva razvoja tehnologije koncentriranih i sušenih mliječnih proizvoda (Retrospective of concentrated and dried dairy products development). Mljekarstvo 53(4):293–307 (2003)

history.zh: 1809 年前后，法国罐头之父阿佩尔把牛奶浓缩到约三分之一，风干后压成片。
history.en: Around 1809 Nicolas Appert, the father of canning, concentrated milk to about a third of its volume, air-dried it and pressed it into tablets.

sources.title: Carić M., Gregurek Lj. Retrospektiva razvoja tehnologije koncentriranih i sušenih mliječnih proizvoda (Retrospective of concentrated and dried dairy products development). Mljekarstvo 53(4):293–307 (2003)

history.zh: 1872 年美国人珀西（Samuel Percy）的专利奠定了喷雾干燥的基础；1902 年 Just 获得早期双滚筒干燥机专利；1955 年前后速溶化工艺让奶粉能快速冲开。
history.en: Samuel Percy's 1872 patent laid the basis for spray drying; Just patented one of the first twin-roller dryers in 1902; instantising around 1955 made powders dissolve quickly.

items.shelf_zh: 晾干的乳扇是薄而硬的片，常温可存放数周到数月（作坊口径）。
items.flavor_zh: 浓郁奶香，烤后外脆内韧、微微拉丝，常卷上玫瑰糖或抹果酱；也可油炸或煮。
items.flavor_en: Intensely milky; grilled until crisp outside and chewy within, often rolled around rose-petal jam; also deep-fried or simmered.
items.how_zh: 鲜牛奶与预先发酵好的酸木瓜水按比例混合，在锅中加热到凝结成絮状，用木勺搅成奶团、滤去乳清，反复揉捏到光亮，再拉伸折叠成薄片，挂在架子上晾干。
items.how_en: Fresh cow's milk is mixed with pre-fermented sour papaya (quince-like Chaenomeles) water and heated until it curdles; the curd is gathered, drained, kneaded until glossy, stretched and folded into thin sheets and hung on racks to dry.

history.zh: 乳扇制作技艺是云南省级非物质文化遗产代表性项目；洱源县 2015 年将其列入县级第三批非遗名录。
history.en: Rushan-making is a provincial-level intangible cultural heritage item in Yunnan; Eryuan County listed it in its third batch of county heritage in 2015.

items.region: 日本（奈良—平安时代宫廷）
items.flavor_zh: 焦糖般的米褐色，带乳糖本身的甜味，质地像半干的奶糖或软奶酪。
items.flavor_en: Caramel-coloured with the natural sweetness of lactose; texture somewhere between fudge and a firm cheese.
items.how_zh: 把牛奶用极小的火慢慢熬煮 7–8 小时，不让它焦糊，熬到原体积的约十分之一、变得黏稠，倒入木模冷却成块。
items.how_en: Milk is simmered over very low heat for 7–8 hours without scorching until it shrinks to about a tenth of its volume and thickens, then set in a wooden mould.

history.zh: 蘇最早见于平安时代的法典《延喜式》（927 年成书）和《政事要略》，记载了令各地造蘇、按轮次进贡宫廷的「贡蘇」制度。
history.en: So first appears in the Heian-era law code Engishiki (completed 927) and the Seiji Yōryaku, which describe a 'kōso' system obliging provinces to make so and send it to court in rotation.

history.zh: 蘇是贵族与官人才能吃到的高级品，用于正月宫中佛事与宴会，也作滋补药用；平安末期以后乳利用在日本中断约四百年，直到明治时代才恢复。
history.en: So was a luxury for nobles and officials, served at New Year Buddhist rites and banquets and taken as a restorative; after the late Heian period dairy use vanished from Japan for about four centuries, returning only in the Meiji era.

methods.principle_zh: 乳酸菌把乳糖变成乳酸，pH 降到约 4.5 以下，多数致病菌和腐败菌难以生长；先占满的乳酸菌还会争夺营养、产生细菌素，挤走杂菌。用上一批的「老引子」接种，就是把这群赢家代代传下去。
methods.principle_en: Lactic acid bacteria turn lactose into lactic acid, dropping pH below about 4.5, where most pathogens and spoilage bacteria struggle; the established culture also outcompetes newcomers for nutrients and makes bacteriocins. Back-slopping from the previous batch passes the winning community on.

methods.principle_zh: 酵母和乳酸菌一起工作，产生少量酒精、二氧化碳和乳酸；酒精与酸叠加抑菌，也消耗掉大部分乳糖。马奶乳糖高、酪蛋白少，特别适合做成低度奶酒。
methods.principle_en: Yeasts working alongside lactic bacteria add a little ethanol and CO2 to the acid; alcohol and acidity together inhibit microbes and use up most of the lactose. Lactose-rich, low-casein mare's milk is especially suited to this.

methods.principle_zh: 微生物需要「可用的水」。水分活度（aw）低于约 0.90 多数细菌停止生长，低于约 0.61 酵母和霉菌也基本停下，低于 0.60 几乎没有微生物能繁殖。晒干的奶球、奶片、奶粉都是把 aw 压到这一线以下。
methods.principle_en: Microbes need available water. Below a water activity (aw) of about 0.90 most bacteria stop growing, below about 0.61 yeasts and moulds largely stop, and below 0.60 almost nothing proliferates. Sun-dried curd balls, milk sheets and milk powder all push aw under that line.

methods.principle_zh: 盐溶在水里，把水「绑住」，降低水分活度，同时造成渗透压，让细菌细胞失水；盐还能在晒干过程中抑制过度酸化和杂菌。约旦 jameed 平均含盐约 15.7%。
methods.principle_en: Dissolved salt binds water, lowering water activity, and its osmotic pressure pulls water out of bacterial cells; it also restrains excessive souring and stray microbes while drying. Jordanian jameed averages about 15.7% salt.

methods.zh: 澄清熬油 / 脂肪隔绝
methods.principle_zh: 细菌只能在水相里生长。把黄油熬到几乎无水（ghee 含水约 0.2%）、滤掉蛋白质，剩下的纯脂肪里微生物无处容身；唯一的敌人变成氧化酸败，所以要密封、避光，或加香料抗氧化。反过来，用油（橄榄油）或脂肪把食物封住，也能隔绝空气。
methods.principle_en: Bacteria live in the water phase. Boil butter until nearly dry (ghee holds about 0.2% water) and strain out the protein, and pure fat leaves microbes nowhere to grow; the remaining enemy is oxidative rancidity, held off by sealing, darkness or antioxidant spices. Conversely, covering food in oil or fat shuts out air.

methods.principle_zh: 把奶熬掉大部分水，再加上大量糖，溶质浓度极高，水分活度降到约 0.80–0.87，多数细菌无法生长；长时间加热同时杀菌，并通过美拉德反应带来焦糖色和香气。只浓缩不加糖（如 khoa）则保存期很短。
methods.principle_en: Boil off most of the water and add lots of sugar, and solute concentration rises until aw falls to about 0.80–0.87, too low for most bacteria; the long heating also sterilises and, through Maillard browning, adds colour and caramel flavour. Concentration without sugar (khoa) keeps only briefly.

methods.principle_zh: 木烟里的酚类等化合物有抑菌和抗氧化作用，烟熏同时烘干表面；东非牧民用特定树木的炭火熏烤葫芦内壁，炭层还能封住葫芦的孔隙。
methods.principle_en: Phenolic and other compounds in wood smoke are antimicrobial and antioxidant, and smoking also dries surfaces; East African herders smoke gourds with charcoal from chosen trees, whose coating also seals the gourd's pores.

methods.principle_zh: 低温让微生物和酶的活动变慢；泥炭沼泽低温、缺氧、偏酸，相当于天然冷库，使爱尔兰的沼泽黄油保存了数百到三千多年。草原和高原的冬季寒冷也是牧民储存黄油、奶块的帮手。
methods.principle_en: Cold slows microbes and enzymes; peat bogs are cold, oxygen-poor and acidic — a natural cold store that kept Irish bog butter for centuries to over three millennia. Steppe and plateau winters likewise help herders store butter and curd.
